apps.name: RagaMentor-iOS
apps.versionDescription: v1.1.1 — Loops screens now follow the web layout and order exactly: chips, then the selected loop name/delete row and note line, then Swaras (header play/Edit/Add, loop sub-line, strip, tempo, meta); backup lives only in More. The A–B tab matches the web rows (head, A/B steppers with Set, Loop toggle + Split, add-loop row), and the fullscreen transport sits above the tabs like the web.
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.

versions.localizedDescription: Loops/A–B screens reordered to the web layout.
